text: Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Keying (T4-001): prose and changed rewritten under the prose rule; dropped the frame 'gives a shared joke' and 'makes every announcement open to the question whether it is meant' (causal, universal, unsupported); now the acts with their rooms (368 of 705) and F-009. Findings touched: F-009 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Boundary work (T4-002): prose and changed rewritten; dropped 'shaped the canvas effort from outside' and 'settled where the work could be talked about' (causal, unsupported: no arrow runs from the host's line to the work) and 'no audience awards it'; now the acts with their rooms (274 of 705) and A20 (132 of 155). Findings touched: F-010 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Sensemaking (T4-003): prose and changed rewritten; dropped 'mostly after the fact', 'what lets a newcomer place a first pixel', 'the same account recruits' and 'rarely tested by its consequences' (unsupported), and 'showed up in every sub at once' (the gate's assumption stated as fact); now the acts with their rooms (283 of 705). Findings touched: F-016 maps Sensemaking to information; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Frame bridging (T4-004): prose and changed rewritten; dropped 'did not meet the canvas with a blank vocabulary' (universal), 'another chapter of the room's story' (a figure), 'how a room makes a strangers' event its own' and 'why the same act is told so differently' (causal, unsupported), 'recruits no one beyond it' (universal); now the acts with their rooms (242 of 705). Findings touched: F-011 and F-013 rest on counts and turns, not on this prose; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Collective representation (T4-006): prose, changed and mistaken_for rewritten; dropped 'before a room can build, it must decide what it will show' (universal and causal, against found marks and A11's order at chance), 'all choices about what the room is, argued as such', 'replaced if lost' (universal) and 'not as what will sell' (a negative parallel); now the acts with their rooms (483 of 705) and F-017's 116 relocations. Findings touched: F-017 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Standardization of output (T4-008): prose, changed and mistaken_for; dropped 'so strangers who never speak can place toward one picture' (universal, causal) and 'binds by reference, not by an order' (negative parallel); C4's sentences kept; now the acts with their rooms (237 of 705). Findings touched: F-016 (division) unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Workarounds (T4-009): prose and changed; dropped 'the collective wish to place faster', 'had to govern them' and 'turns a fixed clock into a capacity some rooms had and others did not' (unsupported); now the setting, the acts with their rooms (236 of 705) and A06 (160 of 203). Findings touched: F-005 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Backstage decision-making (T4-010): prose, changed and mistaken_for; dropped 'many rooms', 'most often a Discord', 'fewer people decide faster', 'speed and secrecy', 'often public' and 'concentrates decision' (vague, uncounted or causal); now the acts with their rooms (276 of 705). Findings touched: F-016 (information) unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Decided order (T4-011): prose, changed and mistaken_for; 'most rooms organized without anyone deciding' now carries F-006's count; 'only the small canvas-born factions come near one' (universal) replaced by F-006's bound with its counts; sources marked recalled; now the acts with their rooms (46 of 705). Findings touched: F-006 and C01 stand; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Collective efficacy (T4-012): prose, changed and mistaken_for; dropped 'that shared belief', 'the other face of mobilization' and 'the belief shapes whether hands come and stay' (causal; the run's own test of doubt then calls holds below its null) and the figure 'may leave the next minute'; now the acts with their rooms (89 of 705), A10 (11 of 21, thin) and F-015. Findings touched: F-015 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Repair work (T4-013): prose and changed; dropped the canvas's erosion stated as a fact of the record, the figure 'the theory question's last clause turns on it', 'whether the work is kept alive depends on' sustained repair (causal, unsupported) and 'never finished before the clock stops'; now the setting, the acts with their rooms (526 of 705, gate work) and A03 (182 of 291). Findings touched: none rest on the prose; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Territoriality (T4-014): prose and changed; dropped 'others mostly treat the claim as real' (uncounted), 'turns a free canvas into a map of holdings' (a figure) and 'no authority recognizes any claim' (contradicted by hosts ruling on requests); now the acts with their rooms (288 of 705). Findings touched: F-012 (hosting) stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Negotiated order (T4-016): prose and changed; dropped 'where tacit restraint was not enough, rooms talked' (causal), 'always facing one difficulty' (universal) and 'it explains why the borders were dense with talk' (causal); now the acts with their rooms (467 of 705), A04 (235 of 401), A17 (95 of 172), the members' words on an agreement's limit [hentai/c0105] and the field's agreement. Findings touched: F-007 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Reciprocity (T4-017): prose and changed; dropped 'constantly', 'rarely free of accounts', 'help creates an obligation to return it' (untested), 'reciprocity explains how rooms could count on hands' (causal) and 'only the room's memory sanctions' (universal); now the acts with their rooms (284 of 705), A13 (171 of 240) and A14 (138 of 214, thin). Findings touched: F-008 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Meta-organization (T4-018): prose and changed; dropped 'it explains how small rooms held space they could not have held alone' (causal, comparative) and 'often one message in a chat, revocable by anyone's pixels' (uncounted, a figure); now the acts with their rooms (146 of 705) and A19 (87 of 121, thin). Findings touched: F-008 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Attribution (T4-019): prose and changed; dropped 'no pixel carries a name, so every change is a puzzle' (a setting fact the contract does not state; universal), 'the attribution decides whether a room repairs, forgives, appeals or strikes back' and 'the hinge between restraint and contention' (causal, contradicted by the run's tests: P06 to P07 at chance, P06 to P09 reversed); now the acts with their rooms (155 of 705, gate work) and the failed tests. Findings touched (rule 14): F-016's mapping line for Attribution says 'No one can see who placed a pixel', resting on the same unchecked fact; corrected next.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Repertoire of contention (T4-020): prose and changed; dropped 'learned and copied from room to room', 'learned in hours by copying' (uncounted diffusion) and 'every rival knew them too' (universal); now the acts with their rooms (231 of 705), A15 (93 of 129), A16 (82 of 104), A17 (95 of 172) and F-014. Findings touched: F-007 and F-014 stand; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Rivalry (T4-021): prose and changed; dropped 'one other room matters more than any other', 'all address that one rival', 'rivalry raises effort and lengthens memory' and 'many carry in from outside' (universal, comparative, causal or uncounted); now the acts with their rooms (116 of 705), A18 (56 of 68), C02 and F-011. Findings touched: F-011 and F-013 stand; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Flagging the nation (T4-022): prose and changed; dropped 'national rooms mostly made its flag' (uncounted), 'it explains why a national room's fights could be told as its history: the membership was in place before the canvas' (causal; F-011 does not support it) and 'noticed by everyone' (universal); now the acts with their rooms (62 of 705), F-011 and C02. Findings touched: F-011 stands; unchanged.

Move (developing or dropping working hypotheses), declaration prose pass, Neo-tribes (T4-023): prose, changed and mistaken_for; dropped 'with no sub behind them at first' and 'exists only on and for the canvas' (universal, against the PurplePixels doubt and P13's range), 'held by affect and ritual' and 'quick to divide' (uncounted), 'ends with the canvas' (universal) and 'as the form pass found' (uncounted findings); now the acts with their rooms (35 of 705) and the doubt carried from C3. Findings touched: none rest on the prose; unchanged.

A21 (tentative, from the field, entered at C4a) lacked negative_check, which the arrow checks of stages C2, C3 and C5 require; set to not-addressed (it is not counted), with a model/history.jsonl line. The C4 check did not read the field, so the C4a close passed without it. Also, rule 14 after the Attribution amendment: mapping-C3.jsonl's line for T4-019 corrected in place; its cannot_do said 'No one can see who placed a pixel', a fact of the setting the contract does not state; it now says the record does not show members seeing who placed a pixel, and that members mistake friendly work for vandalism in 46 rooms. Slip: that Edit and the validator run that checked it ran in one turn.
